missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics showing cause of 503 on /v1/authorizations
Order service logs confirming 502 originates from payment call failure
candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order service to fail POST /v1/orders with 502, which surfaces as gateway /v1/checkout 502s. Inventory reservations succeed, so the failure is localized to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within payment (resource exhaustion, config, crash) is not established; only the 5xx propagation path is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to order service returning 502 on /v1/orders; order's payment call fails with 503 from payment /v1/authorizations, while inventory reservations succeed (200). Gateway metrics show 10.7 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~94ms, so latency is not the driver. Bounded candidate: payment service 5xx propagating as gateway 502.
